description: This source file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of cost records, grouping and aggregating them by agent and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'). The function outputs a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts, including zero-filled categories for consistency across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost record data into a grouped format with aggregated totals by agent and category, ensuring consistent categories across all agents for visualization purposes.
